policyModal.title: Terms & Conditions
policyModal.subtitle: Please read carefully before using the service
policyModal.sec1Desc: Our system (MangaAI Studio) only temporarily stores your images and translations on the server. The system has an automatic garbage collector Bot that permanently deletes all your project data after 2 hours of inactivity to protect privacy and comply with the ephemeral processing model.
policyModal.sec2Desc:
Users are fully responsible for the copyright and legality of the images and manga uploaded to the platform. We only provide tools (AI technology, OCR, Typesetting) and do not hold copyrights or distribute any user works.

Strictly prohibited to upload, process, or translate obscene material (18+ manga, hentai, adult doujinshi), reactionary, or violence-inducing content. Users bear 100% criminal responsibility under Vietnamese law (including Article 326 of the Penal Code on transmitting obscene materials) for any violations.
policyModal.sec3Desc: Strictly prohibited to use automated tools (Bots), send spam requests, or exploit system API vulnerabilities to exhaust server resources. Any violating accounts will be permanently banned without prior notice.
policyModal.sec4Desc: The service is provided "as-is". Although our AI is optimized for comic translation, we do not guarantee translations will be 100% perfect. Users are responsible for reviewing and editing translations before publishing.
